sources.title: Library of Congress: Country Profile, Vietnam, December 2005
sources.note: Direct 21-page report read, historical background printed pages 2 to 3. Used for broad war/postwar chronology, not obsolete current statistics, ancient cultural generalizations or the erroneous romanized-script origin claim. Same work as legacy loc.gov/rr/frd/cs/profiles/Vietnam.pdf.

sources.title: Law Library of Congress: Introduction to the Constitution of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam
sources.note: Original indexed institutional PDF checked for explicit 2 July 1976 change to Socialist Republic of Vietnam. Direct fetch failed. Used for formal state/name distinction, not present constitutional law.

sources.title: U.S. Office of the Historian: Dien Bien Phu and the Fall of French Indochina, 1954
sources.note: Original indexed institutional essay read. Only French defeat and temporary division near 17th parallel adopted. Its oversimplified claims that the United States appointed Diem/established South Vietnam and that Ho directly led a four-month siege are not copied. Retired historical essay, not current policy.

sources.title: UNHCR: Viet Nam, End of an era, Refugees magazine issue 113
sources.note: Original indexed institutional retrospective checked: postwar displacement, dangerous sea departures, 1979 orderly-departure agreement, reconstruction assistance. Direct retrieval failed. Graphic abuse accounts and uncertain casualty totals omitted.

sources.title: World Bank: Viet Nam country overview
sources.note: Direct current institutional overview read; older /en/country/vietnam/overview and /overview.print are the same work. Reforms from 1986, middle-income transition, health/education/infrastructure improvements; current economic forecasts and questionable poverty threshold wording not adopted.

sources.title: World Bank: 2022 Vietnam Poverty and Equity Assessment
sources.note: Direct 2022 report summary checked. Household vulnerability and uneven ethnic/regional conditions; no claims that the national average represents every household.

sources.title: Government of Viet Nam: 2013 Constitution, Chapter I
sources.note: Direct official Vietnamese text read. Articles 4 and 5: Communist Party leading state/society, national language and ethnic language rights. Exact Article 5.3 witness: Ngôn ngữ quốc gia là tiếng Việt. This is the online text of the 2013 Constitution, not its printed original; no claim of a full current consolidated constitution.

sources.title: Ministry of Justice: International and Vietnamese regulations about vulnerable groups
sources.note: Original indexed official English article checked. Quotes Article 5 of the 2013 Constitution including The national language is Vietnamese. Direct page failed. Used only as translation witness; conservatively grouped with constitution itself in work budget.

sources.title: UNDP: For a Vietnam free from mine accidents, 9 May 2019
sources.note: Direct project report read. Army specialist surveys/clearance, Binh Dinh/Quang Binh education, drawings and quizzes, 10-year-old Ngoc. Ignore erroneous photo caption saying warns community to touch bombs; correct body describes leaving objects and notifying adults. No operational handling instructions reproduced.

sources.title: Viet Nam National Authority of Tourism: Tet, Tradition, Reunion and Taste
sources.note: Direct official tourism article read. Reunions, elders/lucky money, visits to teachers and foods. Qualified as many families, not universal. Do not reproduce caste description of teachers, universal ancestor-altars claim or oversimplified banana-leaf claim for all banh chung. Image subdomain and Vietnamese version are mirrors.

sources.title: Viet Nam Tourism: All about Vietnamese water puppets
sources.note: Original indexed official tourism description checked. Contemporary pool shows, buoyant fig-wood/lacquer puppets, bamboo sticks/strings, performers in water. Origin legends and precise medieval chronology omitted.

sources.title: UNESCO: Craft of making Dong Ho Folk woodblock printings
sources.note: Original indexed 2025 nomination 01737 description checked, query variant USL=01737. Hand carving, natural pigments, scallop-powder-coated paper, black final outlines, small number of family workshops and heirloom blocks. Current practice, not dated ancient invention.

sources.title: UNICEF: Bringing mother tongues into the classroom
sources.note: Direct story by Luu Thu Huong read. Teacher Tau, childhood language barrier, 2008 to 2015 pilot, Mong and Vietnamese progression, alumnus De sharing words with mother. Undated story contains explicit dated pilot/photographs. Vietnamese version is the same underlying work.

sources.title: UNICEF: Since we have clean water at school, 24 March 2023
sources.note: Direct report by Ho Hoang Thien Trang read. Pu Nhi school, support from 2019, filters/handwashing/latrines, Nisa aged ten at reporting, teacher Van. Child self-reported illness change is not a controlled health outcome; not used as causal proof.

sources.title: UNICEF: Bringing innovative solutions to help children in Soc Trang
sources.note: Direct project story read. Long Phu C Primary School, Nhu, arrival for installation of Net Zero Aquonic device, solar energy and recycling treated wastewater specifically for flushing. Future installation/scale-up kept distinct from measured completed outcomes; no drinking-water claim.

sources.title: WHO: Viet Nam eliminates trachoma as a public health problem, 21 October 2024
sources.note: Direct official validation report read. Decades of work, SAFE surgery/antibiotics/facial cleanliness/environment, national programme from 1999, thresholds and continuing monitoring. Elimination as a public-health problem is not global eradication or zero infections.

sources.title: WHO: Viet Nam mobilizes forces to push towards malaria elimination
sources.note: Direct 2025 WHO feature read. No malaria deaths in 2024; remaining transmission pockets, staff at remote facilities and planned elimination strategy. No completed malaria-elimination claim. Other WHO regional mirrors count as same work.

sources.title: IMU: Fields Medal, Ngo Bao Chau, 2010
sources.note: Direct official award page read. Fundamental Lemma, algebraic-geometric methods; Hanoi birth, Vietnamese school, France/Princeton career and Chicago appointment. Described as international research, not exclusively domestic achievement.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Committee: Decision 39 COM 8B.6, Phong Nha-Ke Bang
sources.note: Original indexed 2015 committee description read: Son Doong first explored in 2009, exceptional passage diameter/continuity, underground rivers and cave types. Avoid claiming explorers were first people to know the cave, or attributing natural formation to the modern state. Current expanded site 951 is a related but revised assessment.

batchIdentityNotes.note: Exact missing HB record, circa 1960 to open end, alias Socialist Republic of Vietnam. Public overview corrects unified outline and anachronistic state name before 1976. Four decoded features cover north and south from first snapshot; bbox 101.969 to 109.306 E, 8.474 to 23.296 N. Earlier Annam, Cochinchina and French Indochina records inspected and deliberately not associated. No territorial adjudication inferred from polygons. Last phase exclusive 2026 covers 2025 evidence without predicting state end.
